study type: Animal experimental study (prenatal developmental toxicity test)
outcome: Viable fetuses (live birth rate, fetal resorption rate, stillbirth rate)
finding: No treatment-related abnormalities were observed in prenatal developmental toxicity and fetal malformation parameters, indicating that D-allulose had no teratogenic effects on pregnant rats and fetuses.
followup_time: N/A (observations were made on Gestational Day 20, prior to birth)
birth_weight: Fetal body weights were measured at Gestational Day 20.
gest_age: Fetuses were examined at Gestational Day 20.
